explanation: The line is (1,-1,1)+t(2,1,-2), so every point satisfies x+z=2. Thus zero is not on the line. Adding two points gives x+z=4, so addition is not closed. Multiplication by zero leaves the line, so scalar multiplication is not closed. Therefore L is not a subspace, and all four statements are false.
